order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 113 needs public.external_payment_recipients, public.stakeholder_accounts and public.payment_provider_methods (restored Supabase schema, migrations 20260727224957, 20260728120105 and 20260728110453) with the columns the functions use, public.tenants, public.tenant_users, public.aws_user_tenant_ids() (aws/rls/sql/02_helpers.sql), auth.uid() and the roles checksops and authenticated, the three payee tables owned by checksops_admin without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. stakeholder_accounts_origin_check must be the four-value check of supabase migration 20260728110453 (tenant_owned, partner_shared, homeowner_link, provider_connected) or already allow provider_recipient; any other value set refuses (55000 sql113_origin_check_unexpected) and needs its own reviewed change. Apply it before the API change that calls the payee functions (aws_payee_create, aws_payee_reissue_link, aws_payee_disconnect, aws_public_payee_by_token, aws_public_payee_record, aws_payee_apply_status): until then those calls fail with 42883. SQL 113 adds the payee state columns (no PII), the provider_recipient origin, SELECT on external_payment_recipients for checksops and authenticated, and six SECURITY DEFINER functions, EXECUTE checksops only. No later migration replaces it.
